title: Owlshift ticket questions
description:
The questions the runner asked on a ticket, in [`QUESTIONS_FILE`]: each
ask with the comment that posted it, so a brief's thread shows the ask in
that comment's place, and what the last answer check read.

asks.description: Every ask the runner posted on the ticket, oldest first.

checked_through.description:
The newest last-edit time among the decider's comments that the last
answer check to give its verdicts read. Only a decider comment newer
than this, and than the latest ask, is a new answer: an answer already
judged is never judged again on its own.

format.description: The format version of this document.

Ask.description: One ask: a round's questions, or the questions of a round asked again.

at.description: When the comment was posted, as the tracker recorded it.

comment.description: The tracker's identifier of the runner's comment that posted it.

questions.description: The questions, under their ids in the round.

oneOf.description: A round of questions, numbered Q1..Qn.
Questions of a round left open, asked again under their ids.

Question.description: A question for the decider, understandable without any transcript.

category.description: What the question is about, such as `scope` or `security`.

context.description: What the reader needs to know to answer.

QuestionId.description: A question's identifier within a round: Q1, Q2, and so on.
